notes: The competing reading gives *is* to חָכְמָה as a nominal predicate; rule 49's closing paragraph decides for the preposition, since the clause writes no separate English subject and the single nominal beside the prepositional phrase is its subject — the shape of `וּלְיֹעֲצֵי שָׁלוֹם שִׂמְחָה` → *But to the counsellors of peace is joy*.
The protasis writes no conjunction, so *When* is `added` under rule 55 while the apodosis waw takes the *then* written for it (rule 14).
s007 is the preposition אֵת (H854), not the object marker H853, so rule 16 does not reach it.
